title: FedRAMP 20x: A SaaS Provider’s Guide to the Pathway
summary: FedRAMP 20x: A SaaS Provider’s Guide to the Pathway: scope, evidence, limitations, and the decisions buyers need to make.
body_markdown:
For implementation support, review[authorization to operate definition](https://getagency.com/glossary/ato?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=federal&utm_content=fedramp-20x-saas-guide__in_text) and[third-party assessment organization definition](https://getagency.com/glossary/3pao?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=federal&utm_content=fedramp-20x-saas-guide__in_text) . Confirm scope and operating responsibilities before choosing an engagement.


## Which FedRAMP reference should a SaaS company use?


Start with the[current consolidated rules](https://www.fedramp.gov/2026/) and the[official 20x program page](https://www.fedramp.gov/20x/) . Older descriptions of pilots may not reflect the current submission pathways and transition milestones.


Record which version of the rules and definitions your plan uses. Check the applicable class or impact categorization, submission route, assessor responsibilities, and any transition requirements before comparing proposals.


## What changes about evidence and operating work?


The program emphasizes machine-readable evidence and ongoing assurance. That makes the accuracy and maintenance of the underlying evidence important: an automated signal still needs a defined system boundary and an owner.


What changes about evidence and operating work? — comparison Workstream What the provider should establish


Boundary The cloud service, dependencies, and responsibilities in scope


Evidence How the required assertions are supported and reviewed


Assessment Which independent assessment work applies


Operation How changes, exceptions, and ongoing requirements are managed


Agency use What the agency must decide about its own deployment


Use the official rules for normative details. A statement that a service is working toward a program milestone does not establish that the evidence is complete or that the service is currently listed with the claimed status.
